description: Reads the prose out of source files — product strings and, on request, comments — using a tree-sitter grammar so a string that is a path, a flag or an identifier is never graded as a sentence. Read-only: it never writes a program back.
author: Neokapi <hello@neokapi.dev>

formats.name: sourcecode
formats.description: Prose held in source files, located by syntax rather than by pattern.
